findings.title: Same context-bound preflight bytes have mutually exclusive required schemas
findings.details: v3 requires exact status=verified checkpoint without READY/inventory/external_stop fields; guard requires status=READY plus empty default_inventory and external_stop. Their shared preflight path/hash cannot satisfy both.
findings.correction: Agree and bind a shared schema, or separate evidence objects explicitly bound to the same real parent lease and original STOP; add a shared-byte integrated positive and re-freeze/re-review.

findings.classification: timing-contract defect, not an outer-timeout bypass
findings.title: Client timeout10 is not an end-to-end10-second bound
findings.details: Independent virtual-clock test accepts a valid response after18 seconds across9-second connect and9-second readback/receive. Actual v3 separately enforces min(12, remaining_phase_time), so slow valid results fail closed rather than bypass that bound.
findings.correction: Apply one monotonic client-call deadline or specify per-stage bounds accurately and retain outer supervision.
